name: Vyomi Mesh (headless, 2-core)
//: Pro/Max mesh pack: compute + AI only, NO UI, NO forwarded port. Nano is the UI; the mesh dials OUT to the relay with the signed session token. 2-core so the 40h/60h allowance fits GitHub's 120 core-hour free quota (design: docs/architecture/v4.0/MESH-CODESPACES-GITHUB-APP.md).
//sshd: The sshd feature (port 2222) makes `gh codespace ssh` work and gives the Mesh agent reserved host/codespace target (VYOMI_HOST_SSH_ADDR) an sshd to reach. Keep this comment at top level: a key inside `features` breaks Codespace creation.
//capAdd: LLM mesh (docs/architecture/v4.0/MESH-LLM-MESH.md): the mesh joins the WireGuard star with mesh-up.sh (kernel wg, else wireguard-go). docker-in-docker already runs the container privileged (so /dev/net/tun exists); NET_ADMIN is declared explicitly so it still works if that feature changes. Nothing is published.
